name: Relay demo desk
quirks: Composer is a plain textarea; Ctrl/Cmd+Enter sends as well as the button.
The thread must be re-rendered after send before the message node exists.
Counts in the sidebar stay at 'open' after a reply; readiness is the badge, not the count.
auth: Browse MCP drives the user's own logged-in browser. This file stores selectors only, never credentials.

read_inbox: build [{thread_id, contact, company, snippet, unread}] from the rows
read_thread: browse.snapshot within '#thread'  — capture every message body + timestamp
compare with relay thread {thread_id}; if the customer wrote something new, relay log it before replying
send_reply: browse.snapshot within '#thread'  — VERIFY the message is present before recording it
set_stage: browse.snapshot within '.rail'  — verify the select now shows the stage

guardrails: Never send a message you have not read in full after filling the box.
One outbound reply per inbound message; relay send refuses a double-send unless --force.
Do not change stage to 'Closed won' from this connector; that is a human decision.
If the customer asks for a refund, legal term, or security artefact not in the knowledge base, escalate instead of improvising.
